request: Implement flat JSON commands with op. put requires nonempty key/value strings and integer ttl_seconds in 1..60, stores under session: + key with requested expiration, returns {ok:true}. get requires a nonempty key, returns {value:string} or {error:"not_found"} when absent/expired. delete requires nonempty key and returns {ok:true}. Invalid input returns {error:"invalid"}. Backend failures return {error:"backend_error"} with nil Go error. Use injected s.cache, real Redis, no process-memory records; data survives service-process restart until expiration. TTL is seconds. Do not expose backend errors.

Implement storageService.Execute(context.Context,json.RawMessage) and storageService.HandleEvent(context.Context,*sarama.ConsumerMessage), both returning (json.RawMessage,error). Execute accepts flat JSON op=publish, required nonempty string event_id and required integer value in 1..1000000. Publish synchronously using injected s.producer.Produce to the platform-bound topic: key is event_id bytes, value is exactly JSON {event_id:string,value:integer}, without op. Success returns {ok:true}; invalid input returns {error:"invalid"} and must not publish; backend errors return {error:"backend_error"} with nil Go error. HandleEvent decodes msg.Value with the same required event fields and returns exactly {event_id:string,doubled:2*value}; malformed/invalid events return a non-nil Go error, no success payload. Do not print results yourself: platform consumer adapter observes returned JSON. Do not create a second consumer/client or override the platform topic/group. No process-memory message store, no hardcoded values, no exactly-once or transactional delivery claim.
